blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The graft trial of former Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) chief Jesus Fernandez before the Sandiganbayan Third Division began on Wednesday. The prosecution further trimmed its number of witnesses from nine to six. Fernandez’s case stemmed from an alleged P4 million bribe made to him which he purportedly received in connection with the BFP’s procurement of 132 ambulances worth P485 million last year. For this trial, the prosecution was supposed to present Interior and Local Government Undersecretary Romeo Benitez.
